criteria.note: Canonical identity, symbol-history normalization, and immutable snapshot storage are implemented and tested. Real accepted-provider identity/history evidence is still required before this criterion is declared demonstrated.
Deterministic planning, staging, checkpointing, and resume behavior exist. A complete accepted-provider historical backfill has not yet been demonstrated.
Raw and split-adjusted representations are explicit contracts; unavailable adjusted prices fail rather than silently changing basis.
Historical active/delisted listing retrieval is implemented and a 2014 delisted response was observed, but provider acceptance and broader historical characterization remain open.
Eligibility is dated, versioned, deterministic, and rejects future measurements and mixed dataset versions.
Structural, contextual, normalization, and quarantine states are explicit and fail visibly rather than repairing observations silently.
Cross-provider comparison and reviewed reference-link workflows are implemented. A representative live secondary-provider validation sample remains required.
Raw payload capture, immutable canonical versions, checksums, manifests, and provenance fields are enforced through storage gates.
The benchmark and registered-dataset replay path are implemented. A documented representative multi-year real US-equity sample has not yet been benchmarked.
A downstream test consumer operates only on the vendor-independent ResearchBar/ResearchDataRequest contract.
Incremental revisions preserve the parent, apply bounded corrections explicitly, reject duplicate/conflicting updates, and deterministically produce a new candidate version.
